caption: The drawing depicts a large wooden cabinet with a natural wood grain texture and a warm, medium-brown color. The cabinet has two main sections: an upper section with four rectangular doors, each framed with vertical and horizontal panels, and a lower section composed of twelve equal-sized horizontal drawers arranged in three rows of four drawers each. Each of the drawers is fitted with a small round knob. The upper section doors also have two round handles in the middle pair. The cabinet has a flat top with a molded edge and similarly styled base molding. The background is a plain, light beige color, making the cabinet stand out clearly. The perspective is slightly angled, showing the front and a portion of the left side of the cabinet.
title: Cabinet with Drawers
